title: Chestnut and Mushroom Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy stir fry made with fresh chestnuts and mushrooms, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced chestnuts and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until they start to brown.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook for another 2-3 minutes, or until they are tender.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, or until fragrant.
Pour in the soy sauce and stir to combine. Cook for 1 minute, or until the sauce has thickened.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
Garnish with chopped green onions and sesame seeds, if desired.
